lines.zh: : 不对，是{i}你{/i}！
: 你……想要点吗？

lines.en: : Yes! But not in the context you are referring to!
lines.zh: : 对！但不是你指的那个意思！

lines.en: : Kirin, what’s going on? It’s not like you to storm into a room with feelings any bigger than concern for the amount of penises you have inside of you.
lines.zh: : Kirin，怎么了？你冲进房间时带的情绪，向来不会比「担心自己里面塞了几根阴茎」更大，这可不像你。

lines.en: : What’s “going on” is that I was having perhaps the single cutest moment of my young life and that fucking {i}semen demon{/i} showed up and ruined everything!
lines.zh: : 「怎么了」是——我这辈子大概最甜蜜的一刻，被那个他妈的{i}精液恶魔{/i}冒出来全毁了！

lines.en: : Which one? You’ve gotta realize that’s how I see like 90%% of the class at this point.
lines.zh: : 哪个？你得明白，现在班里大概 90%% 的人在我眼里都是那副德性。

lines.en: : Chika! Who else would I come to {i}you{/i} screaming about?! Get with the fucking program, Yumi! Do something!
lines.zh: : Chika！不然我还能尖叫着跑来找{i}你们{/i}说谁？！搞搞清楚状况，Yumi！做点什么啊！

lines.en: : The fuck do you want {i}me{/i} to do? Throw meat at her? I’m eating.
lines.zh: : 你他妈想让{i}我{/i}干什么？拿肉砸她？我正吃着呢。

lines.en: : I don’t care what you do! Just make her go away so I can make passionate love to the teacher!
lines.zh: : 我不管你干什么！只要把她弄走，好让我和老师热情地做爱！
: 为什么现在什么都变得这么麻烦？

lines.en: : Or...sex or...fucking or whatever you want to call it.
lines.zh: : 或者……性爱……操……随便你们怎么叫。

lines.en: : Kirin, tell us exactly {i}what{/i} happened or we won’t be able to do anything about it.
lines.zh: : Kirin，把{i}事情{/i}原原本本讲清楚，不然我们什么都做不了。

lines.en: : Are you not fucking listening? I won’t be able to do anything about it either way. Chika’s like an entirely fuckin’ different person all of a sudden and I ain’t got the faintest fuckin’ idea about how to handle her.
lines.zh: : 你他妈没在听吗？不管怎样我都做不了什么。Chika 突然就像完全变了个人似的，我他妈一点都不知道该怎么对付她。

lines.en: : Okay. But still, Kirin should tell us everything anyway because I’ve never heard her use the phrase “making love” in regard to herself before and I want to know how that found its way into her head.
lines.zh: : 好吧。不过 Kirin 还是该把一切都告诉我们，因为我从没听过她用「做爱」这种词来形容自己，我想知道这话是怎么钻进她脑子里的。

lines.en: : It...It doesn’t matter what led to me learning new phrases! I was just talking to Sensei and stuff and then...you know...semen demon!
lines.zh: : 我……我学会新词的过程不重要！我就是跟 Sensei 说着话什么的，然后……你知道的……精液恶魔！

lines.en: : I’m pressing X so hard right now. You don’t even {i}know.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我现在疯狂地在心里按 X。你根本{i}想象不到{/i}。

lines.en: : Did she swipe him from you or some shit? Because if that’s the case, just let her have him for a little while and wait until she’s done. There ain’t shit any of us can do about it. Girl’s fierce as all hell.
lines.zh: : 她是把他从你那儿抢走了还是怎么的？如果是的话，就让她用一会儿，等她用完再说。这事我们谁都他妈没办法。那丫头凶得要命。

lines.en: : Well, it’s...less like she {i}swiped{/i} him and more like I...{i}gave him away...{/i}
lines.zh: : 嗯……与其说是她{i}抢走了{/i}他，不如说是我……{i}把他让出去了{/i}……

lines.en: : Then take him back, idiot! Telling me is counterproductive when I want him even harder than you do!
lines.zh: : 那就把他抢回来啊，笨蛋！跟我说这些只会起反效果——我比你还想要他！

lines.en: : Nuh-uh! You’re too nice to take him for yourself, so I know you’ll help me! And Yumi’s the only person I know who can probably reason with Chika!
lines.zh: : 才不！你太好了，不会把他据为己有，所以我知道你会帮我！而 Yumi 是我认识的唯一一个大概能跟 Chika 讲道理的人！

lines.en: : Stop using my martyr complex against me! It’s too effective! I’m in!
lines.zh: : 别再利用我的殉道者情结了！这招太管用了！我加入！

lines.en: : Well, {i}I’m{/i} not. I don’t give a shit about whoever is fucking the teacher at any given moment here.
lines.zh: : 嗯，{i}我{/i}不加入。谁在什么时候操老师，我他妈一点都不在乎。

lines.en: : In fact, maybe he can screw Chika back into being an actual human again? Beats me. Only one way to know for sure. Can I eat now?
lines.zh: : 事实上，也许他能操得 Chika 重新变回一个正常人？我哪知道。只有一种办法能确定。我现在能吃了吧？

lines.en: : No. You can eat later. We have to go save Kirin’s heart. This is the first sign of life it has ever showed and I’ll be {i}damned{/i} if I let it slip through the cracks.
lines.zh: : 不行。你晚点再吃。我们得去拯救 Kirin 的心。这是它有史以来第一次显示出生命迹象，我{i}绝不会{/i}让它从指缝里溜走。
: 你干嘛碰我？
: 因为我们相爱啊。
: 不。我们没有。

lines.en: : I’ve already talked you out of wearing the sarashi and I will talk you out of heterosexuality next.
lines.zh: : 我已经说服你不穿裹胸布了，下一步我就要说服你放弃异性恋。

lines.en: : You haven’t talked me out of shit, weirdo!
lines.zh: : 你他妈什么都没说服我，变态！

lines.en: : Those double-D’s say otherwise, damn it.
lines.zh: : 你那对 D 罩杯可不这么说，该死的。

lines.en: : Can you two stop flirting and come help me already?! I want my moment back!
lines.zh: : 你们两个能不能别打情骂俏了，快来帮帮我？！我要把那个时刻抢回来！
: 上蝙蝠车！出发！

lines.en: : Wait! Don’t take my fuckin’ food out of my-
lines.zh: : 等等！别把我他妈的食物从——

lines.en: : You won’t be able to focus if there’s meat around! I know how omnivores function! Kirin, where are we going?
lines.zh: : 周围有肉你就没法集中注意力！我了解杂食动物是怎么运作的！Kirin，我们要去哪？

lines.en: : It’s, like...half a mile that way. Just hug the wall and you won’t get lost!
lines.zh: : 大概……往那边走半英里。贴着墙走就不会迷路！

lines.en: : What are we even supposed to be doing?!
lines.zh: : 我们到底要干什么啊？！

lines.en: The mission was simple — infiltrate the bedroom and find a way to restore Kirin’s first “lovemaking” opportunity.
lines.zh: 任务很简单——潜入卧室，想办法夺回 Kirin 第一次「做爱」的机会。

lines.en: But just because it was simple didn’t mean it would be easy. Chika Chosokabe was rabid after all. And it takes a trained professional to deal with creatures like that.
lines.zh: 可简单不代表容易。Chika Chosokabe 毕竟已经疯了。对付那种生物，得要受过训练的专业人士才行。

lines.en: Or a gun. But Ayane Amamiya wasn’t around. And Kirin wasn’t about to ask {i}her{/i} for help since A — she didn’t know where she was. And B — she didn’t think Ayane would help to begin with.
lines.zh: 或者一把枪。可 Ayane Amamiya 不在。而 Kirin 也不打算找{i}她{/i}帮忙，因为一——她不知道她在哪儿。二——她觉得 Ayane 从一开始就不会帮她。

lines.en: Regardless, Kirin was trying not to think about what might be happening behind that door because she didn’t want her first taste of love being wasted on someone else.
lines.zh: 无论如何，Kirin 都在努力不去想那扇门后可能正在发生什么，因为她不想让自己第一次尝到爱的滋味，就这么浪费在别人身上。

lines.en: At the same time, though, she was beginning to question whether or not it was “love” to begin with if Chika was telling the truth about the way Akira had been spreading himself out.
lines.zh: 但同时，她也开始怀疑：如果 Chika 说的关于 Akira 把自己分摊给那么多人的话是真的，那这到底还算不算「爱」。

lines.en: She was thinking about all sorts of things to try and cope with this loss. Things she didn’t want to say out loud. Things that would embarrass her. Things about the past and things about the future.
lines.zh: 她想着各种各样的事，试图消化这份失去。一些她不想说出口的事。一些会让她难堪的事。关于过去的，关于未来的。

lines.en: But more than anything, she simply didn’t want this to slip away.
lines.zh: 但最重要的是，她只是不想让这一切溜走。

lines.en: For far too long, she’s been letting that happen — pretending she doesn’t want what she {i}knows{/i} she does because she feels like she needs to fit a certain image in order to stand out.
lines.zh: 太久以来，她一直在放任这种事发生——装作不想要自己{i}明明{/i}想要的东西，因为她觉得必须套进某种形象里才能出人头地。

lines.en: But this time — this time, she thought it would be okay to want something. So much so that she didn’t even think about how this might be hurting those she brought here to help her.
lines.zh: 但这一次——这一次，她觉得想要点什么也没关系。甚至到了这种地步：她连自己把她们带来帮忙会不会伤到她们都没想过。

lines.en: If it would even hurt them at all, that is.
lines.zh: 如果那真的会伤到她们的话。

lines.en: They have much thicker skin than she does.
lines.zh: 她们的脸皮可比她厚多了。

lines.en: : They were in there the...last time I saw them.
lines.zh: : 他们刚才……就在里面。我最后一次看到他们的时候。

lines.en: : And you just...left them there? In what is presumably a romantic bedroom with a really soft king-size mattress?
lines.zh: : 然后你就……把他们留在那儿了？在一间应该很浪漫的卧室里，还有一张超软的特大号床垫？

lines.en: : I think it was bigger than a king. It was one of those princess bed things.
lines.zh: : 我觉得比特大号还大。是那种公主床之类的。

lines.en: : Oh, Kirin...You left Sensei and {i}Chika{/i} alone on a princess bed? Leaving him in that situation with {i}anyone{/i} is a recipe for disaster — let alone a girl who, according to Yumi, has gone absolutely cock-crazy.
lines.zh: : 哦，Kirin……你把 Sensei 和 {i}Chika{/i} 单独留在公主床上？把他放进那种情境里，跟{i}任何人{/i}独处都是一场灾难——更别提一个据 Yumi 说已经彻底为鸡巴发疯的女孩。

lines.en: : Okay, for the record, I have never used the term “cock-crazy” in my life.
lines.zh: : 行，先声明一下，我这辈子从没用过「为鸡巴发疯」这个词。
: 可说得很准，不是吗？

lines.en: : I don’t fuckin’ know, man. She’s just...friggin’ delusional all of a sudden. Like she’s thrown out all reason and morals or whatever because she thinks he’ll tell her to fuck off if she doesn’t.
lines.zh: : 我他妈哪知道，老兄。她就是……突然疯魔了。像是把理智和道德什么的统统扔掉了，因为她觉得如果她不这样，他就会叫她滚蛋。

lines.en: : That’s a classic case of cock-craziness, alright. So basically, to help Kirin, we must first help {i}Chika.{/i}
lines.zh: : 这可是典型的为鸡巴发疯，没错。所以基本上，要帮 Kirin，我们得先帮 {i}Chika{/i}。

lines.en: : Help {i}Chika{/i} later. Just rescue Sensei for now so he and I can pick up where we left off and screw-love-fuck each other’s brains out.
lines.zh: : {i}Chika{/i} 以后再帮。现在先把 Sensei 救出来，好让我和他从刚才断掉的地方继续，操、爱、干，把对方的脑子都干出来。
: 明白。

lines.en: : Well, the first course of action is finding out if they’re-
lines.zh: : 嗯，第一步是弄清楚他们是不是在——

lines.en: : {i}Yes! Yes! Harder! Just like that! Oh, fuck! I’m cumming! I’m...fucking cumming!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}对！对！再用力！就这样！哦，操！我要去了！我……他妈的要去了！{/i}
: 呃……第一阶段完成，我猜。

lines.en: : Thank you for forever tainting my ears, Noriko. Now, even if me and Chika {i}do{/i} manage to get close again, I’ll be stuck remembering the way she sounds when she’s getting her back blown out.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你永远玷污了我的耳朵，Noriko。现在就算我和 Chika {i}真{/i}能重新走近，我也会一直记得她被干到高潮时是什么声音。

lines.en: : I’m honestly surprised to find out that’s not something you’ve already heard before.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我很惊讶你居然没听过这种声音。

lines.en: : Yeah! Well, unlike you two, I try to {i}avoid{/i} situations where I’d be bumping into people having sex!
lines.zh: : 对啊！嗯，跟你们俩不一样，我会尽量{i}避免{/i}撞见别人做爱的场面！

lines.en: : It’s not like I’m actively {i}trying{/i} to encounter that! I love Sensei more than anyone! He’s just...having sex like 50%% of his waking life! It’s going to happen if you’re involved with him!
lines.zh: : 我又不是{i}故意{/i}要去撞见！我爱 Sensei 胜过任何人！只是他……醒着的时候大概有 50%% 的时间在做爱！跟他扯上关系，这种事就一定会发生！
: 他{i}当然{/i}只是在撒谎……

lines.en: : That makes way more sense than expecting he’d actually be able to fall for a girl like me.
lines.zh: : 这比指望他真的会爱上我这样的女孩，要合理多了。

lines.en: : Hm? What was that about lying? I couldn’t really-
lines.zh: : 嗯？撒谎是怎么回事？我没太——

lines.en: : Don’t worry about it, Noriko. I’m just making myself look like a fucking idiot again for thinking anyone would ever choose {i}me{/i} over someone else.
lines.zh: : 别管了，Noriko。我只是在又一次把自己弄成他妈的傻瓜——居然以为会有人选{i}我{/i}而不选别人。
: 什么？可你不是——
: 不善良？……
: 不聪明？……
: 不风趣？不体贴？不好看？……
: 为什么？……

lines.en: : Why is it so much harder to name things that I’m not than things that I {i}am?!{/i}
lines.zh: : 为什么说出「我不是什么」比说出「我{i}是{/i}什么」难这么多？！

lines.en: : That’s not what I was trying to-
lines.zh: : 我不是想说——

lines.en: : I...I know! Because you {i}are{/i} good! Too good! Fucking...annoyingly good! You’re the exact type of person who someone {i}would{/i} fall for! I’ve never been that! Not for a day in my life!
lines.zh: : 我……我知道！因为你{i}很{/i}好！太好了！他妈的……好到让人烦！你正是那种{i}会{/i}让人爱上的人！我从来都不是！我这辈子一天都不是！

lines.en: : So why did I fucking {i}believe{/i} it, Noriko?! Why did I think for even a second that I might be wrong about myself?! About who I am and what I’m worth?!
lines.zh: : 那我为什么他妈会{i}相信{/i}啊，Noriko？！我为什么会哪怕一秒钟觉得，我对自己的判断可能是错的？！关于我是谁、我值多少？！
: Kirin——
: 我回家了……
: 谢谢你们肯试。

lines.en: : {i}Now{/i} do you see why I never try to get involved with any of this shit?
lines.zh: : {i}现在{/i}你明白我为什么从来不掺和这些破事了吧？
: 所有这些恋爱啊……性啊……{i}所有的一切{/i}。

lines.en: : All it does is make people fucking crazy.
lines.zh: : 它唯一的用处就是把人逼疯。

lines.en: : Everywhere I look, someone’s either getting hurt or...changing everything about themselves for no reason other than wanting to be with someone else.
lines.zh: : 我往哪儿看，都有人不是在受伤，就是在……为了想跟某个人在一起这种没来由的理由，把自己彻头彻尾地改掉。

lines.en: : Isn’t being alone just...so much safer than that?
lines.zh: : 一个人待着，不比那样安全得多吗？

lines.en: : It is...but we already know that, Yumi. Sensei knows it too. That’s why he’s so desperately trying to push everyone away all the time.
lines.zh: : 是啊……可我们早就知道了，Yumi。Sensei 也知道。所以他才一直那么拼命地把所有人推开。
: 那为什么——
: 因为我们控制不了。
: 我不……
: 我不懂。

lines.en: : Neither do I. But no one said there needs to be logic to any of this. We’re just a bunch of idiots running around trying to experience and feel new things.
lines.zh: : 我也不懂。可谁也没说这些事非得有逻辑。我们只是一群到处乱跑的傻瓜，想体验、想感受新鲜的东西。

lines.en: : You might be perfectly content with just never doing that. And that’s awesome. But Kirin can’t sit still the way you can.
lines.zh: : 你可能永远都不去这么干，也过得很满足。那很棒。可 Kirin 没法像你一样安分地待着。

lines.en: : {i}She’s always wanted someone to look at her. But not like how you and I look at each other. Like...REALLY look at her. As a girl...a woman...a princess...whatever she wants to be that day.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}她一直想要有人看着她。但不是像你和我那样互相看着。而是……真正地看她。把她当成一个女孩……一个女人……一位公主……那天她想当什么就是什么。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}But she’s never felt like she deserves it. So of course she’d take it hard on herself if...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}可她从来都觉得自己配不上。所以如果……她当然会把一切都怪到自己头上。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}If she heard the person she’s been trying to catch the eye of say one thing then do another.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}如果她听到那个她一直想吸引其目光的人，说的是一套、做的是另一套。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Well...what the fuck do you think he said to her then?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}嗯……那你觉得他对她说了什么？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}The same thing you’ll want to hear sooner or later when YOU can’t sit still anymore.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}等到你也安分不下来的那天，你迟早也会想听到同样的话。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}The most terrifying...most amazing thing you could ever say to anyone.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你能对任何人说出口的、最可怕……也最美妙的那句话。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I think that’s what she heard tonight.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我想她今晚听到的就是那句话。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}That’s why I’m not chasing after her.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}所以我没有追上去。{/i}

lines.en: But Noriko didn’t {i}need{/i} to chase after Kirin.
lines.zh: 但 Noriko 并不{i}需要{/i}去追 Kirin。

lines.en: She’d find her way back to normal sooner or later.
lines.zh: 她迟早会自己找回正常的样子。

lines.en: She just needed to hurt a little first.
lines.zh: 她只是需要先痛一痛。

lines.en: And what better place to hurt than all on your own?
lines.zh: 而有什么地方比独自一人更适合伤心呢？
: Kirin？一切都——

lines.en: : Fuck off, Ayane. You’re the second-to-last person I want to talk to right now.
lines.zh: : 滚开，Ayane。你现在是我倒数第二不想说话的人。

lines.en: : What? Who the hell is the last then?
lines.zh: : 什么？那最后一个是谁？

lines.en: : Another blonde! Just...one parading as something she’s not!
lines.zh: : 另一个金发女郎！就是……一个假扮成自己本来不是的样子的人！
: ……Rin？
: 不是！他妈的……呃！
: 圣诞快乐！晚安！
: 晚……晚安？
{i}Kirin 离开了派对！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Her affection is all over the place!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}她的好感度乱七八糟！{/i}

lines.en: And what better place to hurt than in the arms of a rival?
lines.zh: 而有什么地方比在死对头怀里更适合伤心呢？
: {i}你{/i}到底怎么了？
: 哦，{i}你{/i}不是很想知道吗？！

lines.en: : A little, yeah. But only because I’m mildly curious about what sort of tragedy it would take to make you look like you’re actually experiencing human emotions for once.
lines.zh: : 是有点。不过只是因为我稍微好奇，得是什么样的悲剧，才能让你看起来终于像是在体验人类情感了。

lines.en: : Cool! So let’s fucking talk about it then!
lines.zh: : 好啊！那我们就他妈来聊聊吧！
: 什么？

lines.en: : You and me! Let’s talk! Right now!
lines.zh: : 你和我！我们聊聊！就现在！

lines.en: : Why? I don’t want to know {i}that{/i} badly.
lines.zh: : 为什么？我还没想知道到{i}那种{/i}程度。

lines.en: : Because no one else will fucking get it!
lines.zh: : 因为没有别人会他妈懂！
: 而我就会懂？

lines.en: : I don’t fucking know, Ayane! Just come over here!
lines.zh: : 我他妈不知道，Ayane！你过来就是了！
: 呃……你认真的？

lines.en: : So, did one of our classmates rape {i}you{/i} this time?
lines.zh: : 那么，这次是我们哪个同学强奸{i}你{/i}了？
: 显然他妈不是。

lines.en: : Oh, okay. I just figured that since it was something “no one else would get,” it had to be that.
lines.zh: : 哦，好吧。我只是想，既然是「没有别人会懂」的事，那一定是这个了。

lines.en: : She might as well have. Certainly fucking feels like she did.
lines.zh: : 她也差不多就是了。感觉上他妈的确就是。

lines.en: : Yeah, I think you might be lacking some critical understanding of how it feels to be sexually assaulted here.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我觉得你对「被性侵是什么感觉」这件事，可能缺了点关键的认知。

lines.en: : I’m fucking sorry about that, okay?
lines.zh: : 这事我他妈很抱歉，行了吧？

lines.en: : Yup. You’re completely forgiven now. Thanks, Kirin.
lines.zh: : 嗯。你现在完全被原谅了。谢了啊，Kirin。

lines.en: : Ayane, you’re in love with Sensei. Right?
lines.zh: : Ayane，你爱着 Sensei。对吧？
: 当然。

lines.en: : And if I said {i}I{/i} was too...what would you think about that?
lines.zh: : 那如果我说{i}我{/i}也爱他……你会怎么想？

lines.en: : I’d think that you’re a delusional and hypersensitive piece of shit human who could never possibly feel such a wholesome emotion.
lines.zh: : 我会觉得你是个妄想又过度敏感的狗屎人渣，根本不可能产生这么健康的情感。
: 对吧？！
: 你本来不该同意的。

lines.en: : No, I {i}do{/i} agree! Because that’s {i}exactly{/i} how I’m supposed to feel! But all of a sudden, my whole fucking world has been flipped on its head and I don’t know what to do about it!
lines.zh: : 不，我是{i}真的{/i}同意！因为我{i}本来就该{/i}是那种感觉！可突然之间，我他妈的整个世界都被翻了个底朝天，我不知道该怎么办！
: 呃呃呃……

lines.en: : What if I really {i}do{/i} love him, Ayane? How can I ever expect him to {i}actually{/i} love me when I’m like...this?
lines.zh: : 如果我{i}真的{/i}爱他呢，Ayane？我这副……德性，怎么能指望他{i}真的{/i}爱我？

lines.en: : You’re like...the ideal girl. Better than me at virtually everything. Except for maybe, like...blowjobs.
lines.zh: : 你就像……理想的女孩。几乎每一样都比我强。除了大概……口交什么的。

lines.en: : I’m better at those too. I won the contest the second time you forced me into sexually engaging with you. Remember?
lines.zh: : 那个我也比你好。你第二次强迫我和你发生性关系的时候，比赛是我赢的。记得吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, but I’ve improved a lot since then.
lines.zh: : 是啊，可我从那以后进步了很多。
: 好极了。

lines.en: : Either way, I can’t fucking hold a candle to you. So if, for some reason, Sensei {i}did{/i} tell me he loves me...it would totally {i}have{/i} to just be him fucking with me. Right?
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，我都他妈没法跟你比。所以如果 Sensei {i}真的{/i}出于某种原因跟我说他爱我……那{i}绝对{/i}只是他在耍我。对吧？
: 他不会……真的{i}说了{/i}吧。说了吗？

lines.en: : He might have. But it might have also been in the middle of him talking to, like...ghosts or something? I don’t know. It was weird.
lines.zh: : 他可能说了。但也有可能他当时正在跟……鬼魂什么的说话？我不知道。挺怪的。

lines.en: : I’ve never felt this way before, Ayane. I have no idea what to do.
lines.zh: : 我从来没有过这种感觉，Ayane。我完全不知道该怎么办。

lines.en: : Like, it makes total sense for you to be all broken up about him fucking everyone ever. But for {i}me,{/i} that’s only, like...kind of mattered. But now it suddenly matters a lot more and I hate it.
lines.zh: : 比如说，你会因为他操遍所有人而崩溃，这完全说得通。可对{i}我{/i}来说，那顶多只是……有点在意。但现在它突然变得重要多了，我讨厌这样。

lines.en: : And you want...what? My advice on how to cope with that? Even though you’ve effectively traumatized me for life and I want you to go away forever?
lines.zh: : 那你想要……什么？要我教你怎么应对？尽管你实际上已经给我造成了一辈子的心理创伤，而我希望你永远消失？
: 对。差不多。

lines.en: : You have no shame at all, do you?
lines.zh: : 你一点羞耻心都没有，是吧？

lines.en: : Sure I do. I actually feel super bad about the whole sexual assault thing since you took it way worse than I ever expected you to.
lines.zh: : 我有啊。其实我对那整件性侵的事感觉超级糟糕，因为你的反应比我预想的严重太多了。

lines.en: : You expected me to enjoy being sexually assaulted?
lines.zh: : 你还指望我会享受被性侵？
: 也许有一点？
: 这他妈太蠢了，Kirin。

lines.en: : Yeah! That’s why I’m all shameful about it. But at the end of the day, I still like...want to be friends with you and stuff.
lines.zh: : 对啊！所以我才这么羞愧。不过说到底，我还是……想和你做朋友什么的。

lines.en: : Yeah. I, like...really admire you, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我……真的挺崇拜你的，Ayane。

lines.en: : And {i}I,{/i} like...really want to throw up now.
lines.zh: : 而{i}我{/i}……现在真的想吐。

lines.en: : Like it or not, we have a lot in common. So shouldn’t you {i}want{/i} to help me if it means I’ll become less of a shitty person and stuff?
lines.zh: : 不管你愿不愿意，我们有很多共同点。所以如果帮了我能让我变得不那么烂，你不是应该{i}想{/i}帮我吗？

lines.en: : I think you’re overestimating just how much I {i}can{/i} help you.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你高估了我{i}能{/i}帮到你的程度。

lines.en: : There’s no secret method when it comes to coping with the man I love having sex with, like...all of my friends. It sucks. And it’s going to keep sucking forever. But it’s unavoidable when it comes to Sensei.
lines.zh: : 面对「我爱的男人和我所有的朋友上床」这件事，没有什么秘诀。糟透了。而且会一直糟下去。但碰上 Sensei，这是躲不掉的。
: 这样啊，这样啊……

lines.en: : But when he tells you he loves you despite that...you still believe him?
lines.zh: : 可当他尽管如此还是对你说爱你的时候……你还是相信他？

lines.en: : It sounds...extremely stupid when you put it that way. But yeah.
lines.zh: : 被你这么一说，听起来……蠢得要命。不过，是啊。

lines.en: : Do you think he’s just like...poly then?
lines.zh: : 那你觉得他只是……多角恋？
: 我不知道，Kirin……

lines.en: : But what I {i}do{/i} know is that he has an extremely hard time both thinking {i}and{/i} saying those words to anyone.
lines.zh: : 但我{i}确实{/i}知道的是，他无论是对谁，要想到那句话、说出那句话，都极其困难。

lines.en: : So if he said them to you...I doubt he was lying.
lines.zh: : 所以如果他对你说了……我不觉得他是在撒谎。

lines.en: : Stop looking at me like that. I don’t want to feel bad for you.
lines.zh: : 别那样看我。我可不想同情你。
: 谢谢你，Ayane……真的。

lines.en: : And I’m sorry. I’m seriously...seriously sorry.
lines.zh: : 还有，对不起。我真的……真的很抱歉。

lines.en: : I know that we probably won’t ever be friends again after what I did to you. But if you ever-
lines.zh: : 我知道，在我对你做了那些事之后，我们大概再也做不成朋友了。但如果有一天——
: 我们说完了吗？
: 再次抱歉……
{i}Kirin 离开了派对！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Her affection is all over the place!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}她的好感度乱七八糟！{/i}
